name: Brea Summer Volunteens
what_you_do: Volunteer all summer in a city program, such as the pool, day camp, youth sports, preschool or the theater. You build leadership skills and work experience.
who_can_apply: Teens entering grades 9 to 11 who live or go to school in Brea. You must be free all summer. You can take only 5 vacation days.
pay_detail: Volunteer. Jobs offer about 50 to 160 hours.
duration: 9 weeks. The 2026 program was set for June 8 to Aug 7, 2026.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was April 20, 2026 at 5:00 p.m., or sooner if enough came in. 2026 applications are closed. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: Read the guidelines on the program page and apply online when the next round opens. Late forms are not taken. You and a parent must also go to an orientation, held May 20 in 2026.
notes: These are last year's dates. The 2027 dates are not posted yet. Applying does not promise you a spot. The city picks your job based on its needs, but it looks at what you want. Call 714-990-7600.
